sections.title: 4. Eligibility for Admission to Undergraduate Computer Engineering Studies in Germany

items: Students must meet the **university entrance requirements** for the program they wish to enter.
**Educational qualifications:**
**Class 12** or an equivalent secondary school certificate. Mathematics is usually required and physics may also be required.
Academic qualifications should meet the **German university entrance requirements**.
**For Indian students:** Completing **Class 12** does not automatically qualify you for admission to a German bachelor’s degree program.
Depending on the board, subjects, grades and other recognized qualifications, students may have to complete a preparatory course called *Studienkolleg* and pass the *Feststellungs Würfung* .
Prior university education or other recognized credentials may affect eligibility.
Language requirement: **German language skills** at **B2–C1 level** or as required by the university are normally required for **programs taught in German**.
**English-taught courses** may require a **IELTS, TOEFL** or other recognized language qualification.

sections.title: 11. Frequently Asked Questions for Bachelor of Computer Engineering in Germany

items: Q1. Are there computer engineering programs in Germany for Indian students after 12th grade?
Yes, admission is dependent on the student fulfilling the **German university entrance requirements**. Some students might have to complete **Studienkolleg** and pass the assessment test.
Q2. Is computer engineering free to study in Germany?
Many ** public universities ** do semester contributions instead of general tuition for qualified bachelor programs. Some public universities and states charge less than private schools for tuition.
Q3. Is it possible for me to study computer engineering in English in Germany?
Yes, there are a few **English taught bachelors** in computer science or related engineering. Many undergraduate courses, however, are taught in German.
Q4. What is the duration of the bachelor’s degree in computer engineering in Germany?
Most programs take between three and three and a half years depending on the university and the design of the course.
Q5. What is the salary in Germany after studying computer engineering?
Depending on technical skills, employer and location, starting salary might be between **€40,000 and €55,000 gross annually**.
